{{Quote|This is command. Are all the charges in place?''"<br />"''Copy that. We're all ready. The droid army is closing.|Captain Keeli talking to this clone trooper|<ref name="Supply Lines" />}}
A '''clone trooper''' participated in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] under command of [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Keeli/Legends|Keeli]].<ref name="Supply Lines" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Gotcha.|This clone after detonating the charges on the incoming droids|<ref name="Supply Lines" />}}
During the battle of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], this [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] and another clone helped set up explosive charges on a hill near a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] filled with explosives in an attempt to cut off the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] advance through a mountain pass. Once the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] discovered the gunship and came to investigate it, the clones, who were hiding in bushes nearby, detonated the explosives and the hills surrounding the pass collapsed and the route became blocked. Later, this trooper was killed serving by [[Keeli/Legends|Keeli]], who died moments later.<ref name="Supply Lines" />
